wrong_case.label_reason: Judgment call resolved exclude-until-cleared, the closest call in the set: a medium boosted-post pattern (2 posts at 2.1x her own median) stacked on an unresolved conflict flag (paid promo for a competing skincare brand 18 days ago), on adjacent-not-core topic fit (makeup-led). One caveat alone would lean include; two open caveats plus adjacency fail rubric sections 1-3. Flip condition: exclusivity check clears AND the organic baseline verifies — then she re-enters as a reach add.
wrong_case.explanation: No inversion: every labeled-include KOL outranks every labeled-exclude KOL, so the 'wrong case' degrades to the thinnest margin at the boundary. k8 (@gigi.beautypro) is labeled exclude yet scores fit 76/100 at rank 8 — only 10 points below the last include, k11 (@mint.skincarelab, fit 86). The disagreement is structural: the label excludes k8 on the conflict gate and a medium boost signal, but fit_score is a soft ranking over topic/authenticity/recency and deliberately ignores the conflict gate (gates route to human review; they are not ranking penalties). The score answers 'how good a fit, fraud-adjusted' while the label answers 'would we hand this to the brand today' — two different questions that happen to agree on ordering here. This is also where an independent rater would most plausibly flip a label.

caveats: Directional harness, not a benchmark: 11 KOLs, one brief, provisional solo labels.
Labels were auto-drafted from the same curated fixture story the seed data encodes, so high agreement is partly by construction.
